SUPABASE_URL: paste the hosted project's URL here (Project Settings > API)
SUPABASE_ANON_KEY: paste the hosted project's anon/public key here (Project Settings > API) — never the service_role key
STORE_ANDROID_PACKAGE_ID: the Play Store application ID once published, e.g. com.fraternus.app — leave blank until then
STORE_IOS_APP_ID: the numeric App Store Connect app ID once published, e.g. 123456789 — leave blank until then
